newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan life class causes upset.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan life class causes upset.

text.p: A group of Taiwan artists caused a stir when they began sketching a nude female model - they did it in public.
Attempts by authorities in the southern city of Kaohsiung to stop the event on Friday by cutting the power failed when the artists continued in the semi-darkness.
Schoolteacher Wu Su-lien said he staged the event at a local arts centre as an "academic and artistic exploration".
Crowds gathered to watch and the model frequently covered herself with a towel to prevent reporters from taking pictures while the painters worked at their sketches for several hours.
